english.title: Knowingly / recklessly furnish a false return / information to an industrial training board
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly furnished, in pursuance of a requirement made under section 6(1) of the Industrial Training Act 1982,

(A)_[a return]_
(B)_[information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..),]_

which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE FALSEHOOD..)

english.notes:
(i) Section 6(1) provides that an industrialtraining board may require employers in the industry to furnish such returnsand other information of a kind approved by the Secretary of State and to keepsuch records of a kind approved by him and produce them for examination onbehalf of the board as appear to the board to be necessary for carrying out itsfunctions.
(ii) Section 6(8) provides that where an offence under this section committed by abody corporate is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivanceof, or to be attributable to any neglect on the part of, any director, manager,secretary or other similar officer of the body corporate, or any person who waspurporting to act in any such capacity, he, as well as the body corporate,shall be guilty of that offence and be liable to be proceeded against andpunished accordingly.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
